name: Honey Pancakes
description: Fluffy weekend pancakes from organic flour, lifted with baking soda and lemon instead of a mix, served warm with butter and raw honey poured over the top.

ingredients.note: works with the baking soda to lift the batter

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley Grassmilk Organic Whole Milk

ingredients.item: Kriemhild Meadow Butter, melted, plus more for the pan

steps: Whisk the flour, baking soda, and sea salt together in a large bowl.
In a second bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, lemon juice, and melted butter until smooth.
Pour the wet mix into the dry mix and stir just until no dry flour shows. A few lumps are fine, overmixing makes pancakes tough.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes. It should thicken and show a few small bubbles from the lemon and soda.
Heat a skillet or griddle over medium heat and brush with butter. Add 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles hold on the surface and the edges look set, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Serve warm in stacks with butter and raw honey poured over.

name: Fluffy Scrambled Eggs with Cheddar
description: Soft, slow scrambled pasture eggs with melted cheddar folded through. Five ingredients, one pan, and enough protein to actually hold the kids until lunch.

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley Grassmilk Organic Whole Milk
Organic Valley Grassmilk Raw Cheddar and Raw Sharp Cheddar

steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the milk and sea salt, and whisk until the yolks and whites are fully blended and slightly foamy.
Melt the butter in a nonstick or well-seasoned skillet over medium-low heat until it foams.
Pour in the eggs and let them sit undisturbed for 20 seconds, then push them gently across the pan with a spatula, forming large soft curds.
Keep pushing and folding for 3 to 4 minutes until the eggs are mostly set but still glossy and a little wet looking.
Scatter the cheddar over the top, fold it through once, and take the pan off the heat. The eggs finish in the pan in about 1 minute.
Serve right away while the cheddar is still melted and stretchy.

name: Breakfast Egg and Cheddar Wraps
description: Scrambled eggs and cheddar rolled into warm coconut wraps. Handheld, no fork needed, and easy for kids to take to the table or the couch.

ingredients.dbItem: NUCO Organic Coconut Wraps, Original, 5 ct
Organic Valley Grassmilk Raw Cheddar and Raw Sharp Cheddar

steps: Whisk the eggs with the sea salt in a bowl until fully blended.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium-low heat, add the eggs, and scramble gently for 3 to 4 minutes until soft-set and glossy.
Take the pan off the heat and fold in the cheddar so it melts into the eggs.
Warm each coconut wrap in a dry skillet for about 20 seconds per side so it bends without cracking.
Divide the eggs between the wraps, roll them up snugly, and serve seam side down.

name: Baked Egg Cups with Beef
description: Muffin tin egg cups with seasoned ground beef and cheddar, baked in a batch. Make them Sunday and reheat two at a time all week.

ingredients.dbItem: Thousand Hills Lifetime Grazed Ground Beef 85/15
Organic Valley Grassmilk Raw Cheddar and Raw Sharp Cheddar

ingredients.item: Kriemhild Meadow Butter, for greasing the tin

steps: Heat the oven to 375F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin well with the butter.
Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it into small crumbles. Drain off the extra fat and season with half the salt and the pepper.
Divide the beef evenly among the muffin cups and top each with cheddar.
Whisk the eggs with the rest of the salt and pour over the beef and cheese, filling each cup almost to the top.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes until the centers are just set and no longer jiggly.
Rest 5 minutes, run a knife around the edges, and lift the cups out. Serve warm, or cool and refrigerate up to 4 days.

name: Blueberry Honey Oat Bowl
description: Warm organic oats simmered in Grassmilk with wild blueberries, a pinch of Ceylon cinnamon, and honey stirred in at the end so it stays raw.

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley Grassmilk Organic Whole Milk

ingredients.note: Ceylon only, labeled Cinnamomum verum

steps: Add the oats, milk, and sea salt to a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat.
Stir in the frozen blueberries and cook 5 to 7 minutes, stirring often, until the oats are thick and the blueberries have burst and turned the bowl purple.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the Ceylon cinnamon and butter until the butter melts.
Rest 2 minutes to thicken a little more.
Spoon into bowls and drizzle the raw honey over the top at the table so it is never cooked.

name: Steak and Eggs Skillet
description: A diner classic done with one cast iron pan: grass-fed steak seared in tallow, then eggs fried in the same drippings. Big protein, five ingredients.
steps: Pat the steak dry and season both sides with the sea salt and black pepper. Let it sit at room temperature while the pan heats.
Heat a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat, add the tallow, and sear the steak 4 to 5 minutes per side for medium rare.
Move the steak to a plate and rest it 5 minutes. Keep the drippings in the pan and lower the heat to medium.
Crack the eggs into the hot drippings and fry 2 to 3 minutes until the whites are set and the edges are crisp. Cover for the last minute if you like the yolks filmed over.
Slice the steak against the grain, divide between two plates, and top each with two eggs and a spoonful of pan drippings.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
description: A thick, shake-style smoothie with peanut butter, banana, and Grassmilk. Sweet from the banana and a spoon of raw honey, filling enough to count as breakfast.

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley Grassmilk Organic Whole Milk

steps: Add the milk, peanut butter, banana, and honey to a blender.
Blend on high 45 to 60 seconds until completely smooth and slightly frothy.
Pour into two glasses and serve right away, while it is thick and cold.

name: Blueberry Honey Smoothie
description: Wild blueberries blended whole with Grassmilk and raw honey. Purple, naturally sweet, and the fruit goes in with all its fiber, never as juice.

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley Grassmilk Organic Whole Milk

steps: Add the frozen blueberries, milk, and honey to a blender.
Blend on high 60 to 90 seconds, stopping once to push the berries down, until the smoothie is smooth and deep purple.
Pour into two glasses and serve immediately.

name: Tuna Salad Wraps
description: Wild Planet albacore dressed with olive oil, lemon, and a little plain mustard instead of mayo, rolled into coconut wraps. Light, fresh, and ready in minutes.

ingredients.dbItem: Wild Planet Wild Albacore Tuna and Sea Salt

ingredients.item: California Olive Ranch 100% California extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.dbItem: California Olive Ranch 100% California Extra Virgin Olive Oil

ingredients.note: Allergen: mustard. Plain prepared only, no added sugar or flavorings

ingredients.dbItem: NUCO Organic Coconut Wraps, Original, 5 ct

steps: Drain the tuna and flake it into a bowl with a fork, keeping some chunky pieces.
Add the olive oil, lemon juice, mustard, and sea salt, then toss gently until the tuna is coated and glossy. Allergen note: this recipe contains mustard.
Taste and add a squeeze more lemon if it needs brightness.
Warm each coconut wrap in a dry skillet for about 20 seconds per side so it rolls without cracking.
Divide the tuna between the wraps, roll up snugly, and serve right away.

name: Beef and Cheddar Wrap Melts
description: Skillet-crisped coconut wraps filled with seasoned ground beef and melted cheddar, with unsweetened ketchup for dipping. The lunch that disappears fastest at our table.

ingredients.dbItem: Thousand Hills Lifetime Grazed Ground Beef 85/15
Organic Valley Grassmilk Raw Cheddar and Raw Sharp Cheddar
NUCO Organic Coconut Wraps, Original, 5 ct

ingredients.item: Primal Kitchen Organic Unsweetened Ketchup, for dipping

steps: Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat for 7 to 9 minutes, breaking it into crumbles. Drain the extra fat and season with the sea salt and black pepper.
Lay out the wraps and divide the beef and cheddar across them, keeping the filling in the center.
Fold the sides in and roll each wrap up snugly.
Set the wraps seam side down in the same skillet over medium heat and toast 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheddar inside has melted.
Rest 1 minute, halve on a diagonal, and serve with the ketchup for dipping.

name: Peanut Butter and Honey Sandwich
description: The classic lunchbox sandwich rebuilt on allowlist bread: organic peanut butter, raw honey, and banana slices on Base Culture bread.

ingredients.dbItem: Base Culture Original Keto Gluten Free Bread, 16 oz

steps: Spread the peanut butter evenly over two slices of bread, all the way to the edges so every bite gets some.
Lay the banana slices in a single layer over the peanut butter.
Drizzle the raw honey over the banana, then top with the remaining bread slices.
Press gently, slice on the diagonal, and serve.

name: Chicken and Guacamole Wraps
description: Sliced certified organic chicken and ready-made mild guacamole rolled into coconut wraps. Fresh, creamy, and no cooking beyond the chicken itself.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast, certified organic and pasture-raised
ingredients.note: only the certified organic, pasture-raised form passes

ingredients.dbItem: Wholly Guacamole Classic Guacamole, Mild, 7.5 oz
NUCO Organic Coconut Wraps, Original, 5 ct

steps: Season the chicken with the sea salt. Heat the tallow in a skillet over medium heat and cook the chicken 6 to 7 minutes per side until it reaches 165F inside.
Rest the chicken 5 minutes, then slice it thinly across the grain.
Warm each coconut wrap in a dry skillet for about 20 seconds per side so it bends without cracking.
Spread a generous layer of guacamole down the center of each wrap.
Lay the chicken slices over the guacamole, roll up snugly, and serve.

name: Egg Salad Wraps
description: Classic egg salad made with avocado oil mayo and a little plain mustard, scooped into coconut wraps. Creamy, simple, and great made ahead for lunchboxes.

ingredients.item: Primal Kitchen Mayo made with Avocado Oil
ingredients.dbItem: Primal Kitchen Mayo made with Avocado Oil

ingredients.note: Allergen: mustard. Plain prepared only, no added sugar or flavorings

ingredients.dbItem: NUCO Organic Coconut Wraps, Original, 5 ct

steps: Put the eggs in a pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Take the pot off the heat, cover, and let the eggs sit 10 to 12 minutes.
Cool the eggs under cold water, peel, and chop into bite-size pieces. Allergen note: this recipe contains mustard, in the next step.
Stir the mayo, mustard, and sea salt together in a bowl, then fold in the chopped eggs until everything is coated.
Chill at least 15 minutes if you have the time. The flavor settles and the salad holds together better.
Warm each coconut wrap in a dry skillet for about 20 seconds per side, spoon the egg salad down the center, roll up, and serve.

name: Cheddar, Fruit and Cashew Lunch Plate
description: A no-cook lunch plate that works like a kids charcuterie board: sharp Grassmilk cheddar, crisp apples, cashews, a honey drizzle, and a date and cashew bar on the side.

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley Grassmilk Raw Cheddar and Raw Sharp Cheddar

steps: Slice the cheddar and fan it out on two plates or one big board.
Slice the apples and arrange them next to the cheddar.
Scatter the cashews over the plates and set a Larabar Cashew Cookie on each.
Drizzle the raw honey over the apple slices and cheddar just before serving.

name: Chicken and Rice Bowls
description: Simple bowls of soaked white rice and sliced organic chicken with olive oil and lemon over the top. Plain, gentle, and easy to scale for the whole family.

ingredients.note: soak 8 to 12 hours in water before cooking, then drain

ingredients.item: Chicken breast, certified organic and pasture-raised
ingredients.note: only the certified organic, pasture-raised form passes

ingredients.item: California Olive Ranch 100% California extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.dbItem: California Olive Ranch 100% California Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps: The night before or morning of, cover the rice with water and soak 8 to 12 hours. Drain and rinse before cooking.
Add the soaked rice to a pot with 1 1/2 cups fresh water and half the sea salt. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low 15 minutes. Rest off the heat 10 minutes, then fluff.
Season the chicken with the rest of the sea salt. Heat 1 tbsp of the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the chicken 6 to 7 minutes per side until it reaches 165F inside.
Rest the chicken 5 minutes, then slice it thinly.
Divide the rice between four bowls, top with the sliced chicken, drizzle the remaining olive oil over everything, and serve with lemon wedges to squeeze over.

description: A plain, tender meatloaf like the one everyone grew up with, glazed with unsweetened ketchup. It is made with the Ancestral Blend, so it honestly contains beef liver and heart ground in with the beef, but it tastes like regular meatloaf and the kids will never know unless you tell them.

ingredients.dbItem: Force of Nature Ground Beef and Bison range (incl. Ancestral Blend)
ingredients.item: Force of Nature Ancestral Blend ground beef (ground beef with beef liver and beef heart)
ingredients.note: the organ meats are already ground in and mild tasting; Thousand Hills ground beef works too

ingredients.item: Primal Kitchen Organic Unsweetened Ketchup, divided
ingredients.note: half mixed in, half spread on top as the glaze

name: Family Meatloaf with Ketchup Glaze
steps: Heat the oven to 350F. Set a rimmed baking sheet or a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan on the counter.
Put the Ancestral Blend in a large bowl. Add the egg, diced onion, garlic, 1/4 cup of the ketchup, the salt, and the pepper.
Mix with clean hands just until everything is combined, about 30 seconds. Overmixing makes meatloaf dense, so stop as soon as you see no streaks of egg.
Shape the mix into a loaf about 8 by 4 inches on the baking sheet, or press it gently into the loaf pan.
Spread the remaining 1/4 cup ketchup over the top in an even layer.
Bake for 55 to 60 minutes, until the center reads 160F on a meat thermometer and the juices run clear.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing so the slices hold together. Serve warm, with the pan juices spooned over.

description: Thin, crispy-edged burgers smashed on a hot pan, topped with real cheddar and served on toasted Base Culture bread or wrapped in a coconut wrap. Weeknight fast and genuinely filling.

ingredients.dbItem: Thousand Hills Lifetime Grazed Ground Beef 85/15
ingredients.item: Thousand Hills Lifetime Grazed Ground Beef 85/15

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley Grassmilk Raw Cheddar and Raw Sharp Cheddar
ingredients.item: Organic Valley Grassmilk Raw Cheddar, sliced

ingredients.dbItem: Base Culture Original Keto Gluten Free Bread, 16 oz
ingredients.item: Base Culture Original Keto Bread, toasted
ingredients.note: or skip the bread and wrap each burger in a NUCO Organic Coconut Wrap
mustard is a major allergen, always mention it at the table
just enough to film the pan

name: Smash Burgers with Cheddar
steps: Divide the beef into 8 loose balls of 2 oz each. Do not pack them tight and do not season yet.
Heat a large cast iron pan over medium-high heat until it just starts to smoke, about 3 minutes. Film it with the tallow.
Add 4 balls, spaced apart. Press each one flat with a sturdy spatula to about 1/4 inch thick. Season with half the salt and pepper.
Cook undisturbed for 2 minutes until the edges are brown and crisp. Scrape under each patty firmly, flip, and cook 1 more minute.
Stack two patties per burger, lay a cheddar slice on each stack, and cook 30 seconds more until the cheese melts.
Repeat with the remaining 4 balls while the first burgers rest.
Serve each double stack on a toasted bread slice (open face) or in a coconut wrap, with ketchup and a thin smear of mustard.

description: One bird, one pan of root vegetables roasting in the chicken drippings, and almost no work after the first 15 minutes. The classic Sunday dinner that also works on a weeknight.

ingredients.note: only certified organic and pasture-raised passes

ingredients.item: Root vegetables (potatoes, carrots, sweet potatoes, or a mix), cut in 1 1/2 inch chunks

ingredients.note: or beef tallow

name: Whole Roast Chicken with Root Vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 425F. Take the chicken out of the fridge 20 minutes before cooking so it roasts evenly.
Spread the root vegetable chunks in a large roasting pan or cast iron skillet. Sprinkle with half the salt and pepper.
Pat the chicken very dry with towels. Rub the softened butter all over the skin, then season with the remaining salt and pepper. Put the smashed garlic inside the cavity.
Tie the legs together with kitchen string if you have it, and set the chicken breast-side up right on top of the vegetables.
Roast for 1 hour 10 minutes to 1 hour 20 minutes, until the thigh reads 165F and the juices run clear when you cut between the leg and body.
Rest the chicken 15 minutes before carving. The vegetables finish in the drippings while it rests.
Carve and serve with a pile of the roasted roots and pan juices spooned over everything.

description: Real chicken tenders with a light organic flour crust, fried golden in tallow, with a two-ingredient honey mustard for dipping. The dip is sweet from raw honey only, and the mustard in it is a major allergen, so say it out loud when you serve it.

ingredients.item: Certified organic chicken breast, cut into strips about 1 inch wide
ingredients.note: only certified organic and pasture-raised passes
certified organic, unenriched and unbleached

ingredients.item: Vital Farms Organic Pasture-Raised Eggs, beaten

ingredients.note: for shallow frying; Fatworks Grass-Fed Beef Tallow works
for the dip
for the dip; mustard is a major allergen, always mention it at the table

name: Crispy Chicken Tenders with Honey Mustard
steps: Pat the chicken strips dry and season with 1 tsp of the salt and the pepper.
Set up two shallow bowls: the flour mixed with the remaining 1/2 tsp salt in one, the beaten eggs in the other.
Coat each strip in flour, then egg, then flour again. Set the coated strips on a plate and let them sit 5 minutes so the crust sets.
Stir the honey and mustard together in a small bowl for the dip. Set aside.
Heat the tallow in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers, about 350F.
Fry the strips in batches, 3 to 4 minutes per side, until deep golden and the chicken reads 165F. Do not crowd the pan.
Drain on a rack or paper towels for 2 minutes, sprinkle with a pinch of salt, and serve hot with the honey mustard.

description: Chunks of grass-fed beef simmered low and slow with potatoes and carrots until everything is spoon-tender. No flour, no wine, no fuss, and it reheats better the next day.

ingredients.item: Thousand Hills stew meat, cut in 1 1/2 inch chunks
Root vegetables (potatoes and carrots), cut in 1 inch chunks

ingredients.note: enough to just cover the meat

name: Beef Stew with Root Vegetables
steps: Pat the beef chunks dry and season with the salt and pepper. Dry meat browns, wet meat steams.
Heat the tallow in a heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the beef in two batches, about 4 minutes per batch, and set aside.
Lower the heat to medium. Cook the onion in the drippings for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the spring water and scrape up every browned bit from the bottom of the pot. That is the flavor.
Return the beef and any juices. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook on low for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Add the root vegetables, cover again, and simmer 30 more minutes until the beef and vegetables are both tender.
Taste, add salt if needed, and serve in bowls with plenty of the broth.

description: Italian shell pasta folded through a simple beef and marinara ragu. Three real ingredients do all the work, and it is on the table in about 40 minutes.

ingredients.note: quality Italian pasta only

ingredients.dbItem: Thousand Hills Lifetime Grazed Ground Beef 85/15
ingredients.item: Thousand Hills Lifetime Grazed Ground Beef 85/15

ingredients.dbItem: California Olive Ranch 100% California Extra Virgin Olive Oil
ingredients.item: California Olive Ranch 100% California Extra Virgin Olive Oil
ingredients.note: only the 100% California bottle

ingredients.amount: 1 tsp, plus more for the pasta water

name: Conchiglie with Beef Ragu
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the pasta.
Heat the olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the ground beef, break it into small crumbles, and cook 6 to 8 minutes until well browned. Season with the salt.
Pour in the marinara, stir, and let the ragu simmer gently for 15 minutes while the pasta cooks.
Cook the conchiglie in the boiling water until just tender, about 10 to 12 minutes. Save 1 cup of the pasta water before draining.
Add the drained pasta to the ragu with a splash of pasta water and toss over low heat for 1 minute so the sauce coats every shell.
Serve in warm bowls, family style, straight from the pan.

description: Real stovetop mac and cheese with a lentil penne that brings serious protein and a sauce of nothing but cheddar, milk, and butter. Buy the 100% lentil box only; the lentil and brown rice blend box does not pass.

ingredients.dbItem: Felicia Organic Red Lentil Penne, 8 oz
ingredients.item: Felicia Organic Red Lentil Penne, 100% lentil box
ingredients.note: check the box: the lentil and brown rice blend variant is banned

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley Grassmilk Raw Cheddar and Raw Sharp Cheddar
ingredients.item: Organic Valley Grassmilk Raw Cheddar, grated

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley Grassmilk Organic Whole Milk
ingredients.item: Organic Valley Grassmilk Organic Whole Milk

ingredients.amount: 1 tsp, plus more for the pasta water

name: Homemade Mac and Cheese
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the penne until just tender, about 8 to 9 minutes. Save 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.
While the pasta cooks, grate the cheddar. Pre-grated cheese melts worse, so grate it fresh if you can.
Return the empty pot to low heat. Melt the butter, then pour in the milk and warm it until steaming, about 3 minutes. Do not boil it.
Take the pot off the heat. Add the cheddar a handful at a time, stirring until each handful melts before adding the next. Off the heat is what keeps the sauce smooth instead of grainy.
Stir in the salt. If the sauce feels thick, loosen it with a splash of the saved pasta water.
Fold the drained penne through the sauce until every piece is coated.
Serve right away in warm bowls. Mac and cheese waits for nobody.

description: Wild salmon fillets with crisp skin, finished with butter, garlic, and a squeeze of fresh lemon. Fifteen minutes of cooking and it tastes like a restaurant plate.

ingredients.item: Fresh lemon, half for juice and half cut in wedges

ingredients.note: for the pan; California Olive Ranch 100% California oil also works

name: Salmon with Lemon Butter
steps: Pat the salmon very dry, especially the skin. Season the flesh with the salt and pepper.
Heat the tallow in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Lay the fillets in skin-side down and press each one gently for 10 seconds so the skin stays flat. Cook undisturbed for 6 minutes until the skin is crisp and releases easily.
Flip and cook 1 to 2 more minutes until the center is just opaque, 125F for medium. Move the fish to warm plates.
Lower the heat. Melt the butter in the same pan, add the garlic for 30 seconds, then squeeze in the juice of half the lemon and swirl.
Spoon the lemon butter over the fillets and serve with the lemon wedges.

description: Plump wild shrimp tossed in garlic butter over a bed of soaked white rice that soaks up every drop. The rice needs an overnight soak, so start it the night before and dinner itself takes half an hour.

ingredients.note: soaked 8 to 12 hours in water with a squeeze of lemon, then drained; soak overnight
for the rice

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp over Soaked Rice
steps: The night before, put the rice in a bowl, cover with water plus a squeeze of lemon, and soak 8 to 12 hours. Drain before cooking.
Put the drained rice and the spring water in a pot with half the salt. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on the lowest heat for 15 minutes. Rest off the heat for 5 minutes, then fluff.
While the rice cooks, pat the shrimp very dry and season with the remaining salt.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic for 30 seconds until it smells sweet, not brown.
Add the shrimp in one layer. Cook 2 minutes per side until pink and just curled. Do not overcook; they turn rubbery fast.
Squeeze lemon over the shrimp and swirl the pan so the garlic butter coats everything.
Serve the shrimp and all the pan butter over the rice, with extra lemon wedges.

description: Thick pork chops with apples baked right alongside in butter, a little raw honey, and Ceylon cinnamon. Sweet and savory in the way kids actually like, with no added sugar.

ingredients.item: Pork chops, bone-in, about 1 inch thick
Whole apples, cored and cut in wedges

ingredients.note: Ceylon only; unlabeled generic cinnamon is usually cassia and does not pass
for searing the chops

name: Pork Chops with Baked Apples
steps: Heat the oven to 400F. Take the chops out of the fridge 15 minutes ahead and season with the salt and pepper.
Toss the apple wedges in a baking dish with the melted butter, honey, and Ceylon cinnamon until coated.
Heat the tallow in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chops 3 minutes per side until golden.
Spoon the apples and their juices around and over the chops in the skillet, or move everything to the baking dish.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the chops read 145F and the apples are soft.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve each chop with a pile of baked apples and the pan juices spooned over.

description: Steak and root vegetables roasted together on one pan in tallow until the edges caramelize. Fifteen minutes of prep, one pan to wash, and steakhouse flavor on a weeknight.

ingredients.item: Thousand Hills steak (strip or sirloin), about 1 inch thick
Root vegetables (potatoes, carrots, sweet potatoes), cut in 1 inch chunks

name: Sheet-Pan Steak and Roasted Roots
steps: Heat the oven to 450F. Take the steak out of the fridge 20 minutes ahead so it cooks evenly.
Toss the root vegetables on a large sheet pan with half the melted tallow, half the salt, and half the pepper. Spread them out in one layer with space between pieces.
Roast the vegetables for 15 minutes to give them a head start.
Pat the steak dry. Rub with the remaining tallow, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Push the vegetables to the edges and lay the steak in the center of the hot pan. Roast 8 minutes, flip the steak, and roast 5 to 7 more minutes for medium-rare (130F) to medium (140F).
Rest the steak on a board for 10 minutes, then slice against the grain.
Serve the sliced steak over the roasted roots with the pan juices poured over.

description: The soup every family needs in rotation: organic chicken, root vegetables, and soaked rice in a clear golden broth. Gentle, filling, and exactly what a sick day or a cold night calls for.

ingredients.item: Certified organic chicken thighs, bone-in and skin-on
ingredients.note: only certified organic and pasture-raised passes
soaked 8 to 12 hours in water with a squeeze of lemon, then drained

name: Chicken Soup with Rice
steps: Put the chicken thighs in a large pot with the spring water and 1 tsp of the salt. Bring to a boil, skim off any foam, then lower to a gentle simmer for 30 minutes.
Lift the chicken out onto a plate. When it is cool enough to handle, pull the meat off the bones in bite-size pieces and discard the skin and bones.
Return the broth to a simmer. Add the onion, garlic, and root vegetables and cook for 15 minutes.
Stir in the drained soaked rice and simmer 12 to 15 more minutes until the rice is tender.
Return the chicken meat to the pot with the remaining salt and the pepper. Simmer 5 minutes to heat through.
Taste and adjust the salt. A soup this simple lives and dies on seasoning.
Serve in big bowls with plenty of broth in every serving.

name: Honey Peanut Butter Cookies
description: The easiest cookie on the site: one bowl, five ingredients, sweetened only with raw honey. Soft in the middle, with the classic fork crosshatch on top.

ingredients.note: Nate's Raw & Unfiltered is the listed jar

steps: Stir the peanut butter, honey, egg, vanilla, baking soda, and sea salt together in one bowl until smooth and glossy.
Chill the dough for 30 minutes. Honey dough is loose at room temperature and spreads too much if it goes straight into the oven.
Heat the oven to 325F, a little lower than a sugar cookie, because honey browns faster. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Scoop the dough into 12 balls, about 2 tablespoons each, and set them 2 inches apart on the sheet.
Press the classic crosshatch into each ball with the back of a fork, flattening them to about 1/2 inch thick.
Bake 9 to 11 minutes, until the edges look set and the centers still look slightly soft. Pull them early rather than late; they firm up as they cool.
Cool on the pan for 10 minutes before moving. Warm honey cookies are fragile, cold ones are sturdy.

name: Honey Sugar Cookies with Strawberry Frosting
description: A soft frosted cookie rebuilt without sugar: the dough runs on butter and raw honey, the frosting is whipped honey butter, and crushed freeze-dried strawberries stand in for sprinkles.

ingredients.note: Certified organic, unenriched, unbleached, unbromated
For the dough
For the dough
The extra yolk is what keeps these soft without sour cream
For the frosting
For the frosting

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley | Grassmilk Organic Whole Milk
ingredients.note: For the frosting, just enough to make it spreadable

ingredients.dbItem: Brothers All Natural | Freeze Dried Strawberry Fruit Crisps, 1 oz
ingredients.note: The sprinkle stand-in: real fruit, no sugar, no dyes

steps: Beat the 1/2 cup softened butter with the 1/2 cup honey until pale and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Beat in the egg, the yolk, and the vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda, and sea salt until a soft dough forms. It will be softer than a sugar dough; that is the honey.
Chill the dough at least 30 minutes, up to overnight. Cold dough is what keeps these thick instead of spreading into lace.
Heat the oven to 325F. Scoop 12 balls onto a parchment-lined sheet, 2 inches apart, and flatten slightly with the bottom of a glass.
Bake 9 to 11 minutes, until the edges are just set and the tops still look pale. Honey cookies brown fast and go from soft to crisp in a minute, so pull them early.
Cool completely on a rack. Warm cookies crumble under frosting.

For the frosting, whip the 1/4 cup butter with the 3 tablespoons honey until light, then beat in the milk and a pinch of the vanilla if you like. It is a soft honey butter frosting, closer to a thick glaze than a bakery buttercream, and that is honest.
Spread frosting on each cooled cookie and shower with crushed freeze-dried strawberries right away, while the frosting is tacky. Serve the same day for the crunch.

name: Carob Brownies
description: Fudgy, dark, and sweet, but this is carob, not chocolate: a naturally sweet pod powder with zero caffeine, so kids can eat one after dinner without bouncing off the walls. It tastes like itself, malty and rich, and it does not pretend to be cocoa.

ingredients.note: Single-ingredient carob only; this is the chocolate stand-in and is named carob on purpose

steps: Heat the oven to 325F, lower than a cocoa brownie, because honey and carob both brown quickly. Line an 8x8 inch pan with parchment.
Whisk the melted butter and honey together until glossy. Whisk in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Fold in the carob powder, flour, and sea salt until just combined. The batter will be thick and dark, like a brownie batter should be.
Spread the batter evenly in the pan, getting it into the corners.
Bake 22 to 25 minutes, until the edges are set and a toothpick in the center comes out with moist crumbs, not wet batter. Carob brownies go dry if you push them to a clean toothpick.
Cool in the pan at least 20 minutes. They set as they cool and slice cleanly once barely warm.
Cut into 9 squares. Leftovers keep 3 days covered at room temperature, and the flavor deepens on day two.

name: Honey Vanilla Cake
description: A real birthday-style layer cake with no sugar anywhere: honey does the sweetening, a squeeze of lemon wakes up the baking soda for lift, and the frosting is whipped honey butter.

ingredients.note: Certified organic, unenriched, unbleached, unbromated
For the cake
For the cake

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley | Grassmilk Organic Whole Milk

ingredients.note: For the cake
Acid that activates the soda for lift
For the frosting
For the frosting
For the frosting

steps: Heat the oven to 325F, lower than a sugar cake, because honey caramelizes fast. Butter a 9 inch round pan and line the bottom with parchment.
Beat the 1/2 cup butter with the 3/4 cup honey until pale and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the 2 teaspoons vanilla.
Stir the flour, baking soda, and sea salt together in a second bowl.

Add half the flour mixture to the butter bowl, then the milk and lemon juice, then the rest of the flour. Mix only until no dry streaks remain; the lemon and soda will fizz lightly, and that fizz is your lift.

Scrape the batter into the pan and smooth the top. Bake 30 to 35 minutes, until the center springs back and a toothpick comes out clean. If the top darkens early, tent it loosely with parchment for the last 10 minutes.
Cool in the pan 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack and cool completely. A warm cake melts honey butter frosting on contact.
Whip the frosting butter with the 1/3 cup honey and 1 teaspoon vanilla until light and spreadable, about 3 minutes.
Frost the top (and sides, if you stretched the frosting thin), slice into 8, and serve the same day. The crumb stays moist into day two, covered.

name: Homemade Honey Vanilla Ice Cream
description: A proper cooked custard ice cream sweetened only with raw honey. The method works in a churn, and the no-machine freeze-and-stir version is written right into the steps.

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley | Grassmilk Organic Whole Milk

ingredients.note: Save the whites for breakfast eggs
Added off the heat so its flavor stays alive

steps: Warm the milk and cream in a saucepan over medium heat until steaming with small bubbles at the edge, about 5 minutes. Do not boil.
Whisk the yolks in a bowl. Slowly ladle in about a cup of the hot milk, whisking constantly, to warm the yolks without scrambling them.

Pour the yolk mixture back into the pan. Cook over medium-low, stirring constantly with a spoon, until it thickens enough to coat the back of the spoon, 5 to 8 minutes, about 170 to 175F. Do not let it boil.
Take the pan off the heat. Stir in the honey, vanilla, and sea salt until the honey melts in completely.
Pour through a fine strainer into a bowl, cover, and chill until completely cold, at least 2 hours or overnight. A warm base makes icy ice cream.
With a machine: churn in your ice cream maker 20 to 25 minutes, until thick and soft-serve consistency, then freeze in a covered container at least 2 hours to firm up.

No machine: pour the cold base into a shallow metal pan and freeze. Every 30 minutes for about 3 hours, scrape and stir it vigorously with a fork or whisk, breaking up the ice crystals. The texture is a touch denser than churned, and the flavor is identical.
Serve in small scoops. Let it sit at room temperature 5 to 10 minutes if it froze rock hard; honey ice cream softens fast.

name: Ice Cream Cake
description: The party build: a base of the Honey Sugar Cookies dough baked as one big cookie in a springform, a full layer of the Homemade Honey Vanilla Ice Cream, honey butter frosting, and crushed freeze-dried strawberries on top. Make the two component recipes first (they are on this site), then assemble here.

ingredients.note: For the cookie base (Honey Sugar Cookies dough)
1/2 cup for the cookie base, 1/4 cup for the frosting
1/2 cup base, 1/2 cup ice cream, 1/3 cup + 3 tbsp frosting and base sweetening per the component recipes
1 egg plus 1 yolk for the base, 4 yolks for the ice cream
For the cookie base

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley | Grassmilk Organic Whole Milk
ingredients.note: 2 cups for the ice cream, 1 tbsp for the frosting
For the ice cream layer

ingredients.dbItem: Brothers All Natural | Freeze Dried Strawberry Fruit Crisps, 1 oz
ingredients.note: The decoration, standing in for sprinkles

steps: Make the Honey Sugar Cookies dough exactly as that recipe directs, but keep it as one batch of dough instead of scooping cookies. Chill it 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 325F. Press the chilled dough evenly into the bottom of a 9 inch springform pan lined with parchment.

Bake 13 to 15 minutes, until the edges are set and the center is just barely done. This base has to slice, not crumble, so a slight underbake is right. Cool completely in the pan, then freeze the base in the pan for 30 minutes.

Meanwhile make the Homemade Honey Vanilla Ice Cream base, chill it, and churn (or freeze-and-stir) only until it reaches a thick, spreadable soft-serve texture. Stop early: it finishes firming in the cake.
Spread the soft ice cream over the frozen cookie base in an even layer, smoothing the top. Cover and freeze at least 4 hours, overnight is better.
Whip the frosting: 1/4 cup softened butter beaten with 1/3 cup honey and 1 tablespoon milk until light, the same frosting as the Honey Sugar Cookies.
Run a warm knife around the springform, release the cake, and spread the frosting over the frozen top, working quickly before the surface softens.
Shower the top with crushed freeze-dried strawberries, return to the freezer 15 minutes to set the frosting, then slice with a hot knife, wiping between cuts. Serve straight from the freezer.

name: Baked Apples with Honey Butter and Cashews
description: Whole apples baked until soft with honey butter and chopped cashews melting into the middle, finished with Ceylon cinnamon. It tastes like pie filling without any crust or sugar.

ingredients.note: Ceylon (true) cinnamon only; unlabeled generic cinnamon is usually cassia and does not meet the list condition

steps: Heat the oven to 350F. Core the apples from the top, leaving the bottom 1/2 inch intact so the filling stays in, and set them in a small baking dish.
Stir the melted butter, honey, chopped cashews, and Ceylon cinnamon together in a small bowl.
Spoon the mixture into the cored centers, dividing it evenly, and let the extra drizzle over the tops.
Pour about 1/2 inch of water into the bottom of the dish to keep the skins from splitting dry.
Bake 30 to 40 minutes, until the apples are soft all the way through when pierced with a knife but still holding their shape.
Rest 5 minutes (the honey butter inside is lava hot), then serve warm, one apple per person, with the pan juices spooned over.

name: Date and Cashew Bars
description: Two main ingredients and a pinch of salt, pressed into bars: the homemade version of the one store bar that passes the list. No baking, no sweetener added, the dates do all of it.

ingredients.note: Whole fruit; if dry, soak in warm water 10 minutes and drain well

steps: Pulse the cashews in a food processor until they are coarse crumbs with a few pea-size pieces left. Tip them into a bowl; do not keep going or you will make cashew butter.
Process the pitted dates until they form a thick, sticky paste that clumps into a ball, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the cashews and sea salt back in and pulse 6 to 8 times, just until the mixture holds together when pinched. It should look like coarse cookie dough.
Press the mixture firmly and evenly into a parchment-lined 8x8 inch pan. Really lean on it; loose bars crumble.
Chill at least 1 hour, until firm enough to slice cleanly.
Cut into 8 bars. Store in the fridge up to a week or freeze for a month; they are best cold, straight from the fridge.

name: Rice Pudding with Honey and Cinnamon
description: Old-fashioned stovetop rice pudding, soaked rice simmered in Grassmilk until creamy, sweetened with honey at the end and dusted with Ceylon cinnamon. Comfort food for slow evenings.

ingredients.note: Soak 8 to 12 hours in water, then drain; the traditional preparation the list condition rests on

ingredients.dbItem: Organic Valley | Grassmilk Organic Whole Milk

ingredients.note: Stirred in off the heat so the flavor survives

ingredients.amount: 1/2 tsp, plus more for the top
ingredients.note: Ceylon (true) cinnamon only, per the list condition

steps: Soak the white rice in water for 8 to 12 hours (overnight is easiest), then drain. This traditional step is how the list clears white rice, and it shortens the cooking.
Combine the drained rice, milk, and sea salt in a heavy saucepan. Bring to a bare simmer over medium heat, stirring so the rice does not catch.
Drop the heat to low and simmer gently 25 to 30 minutes, stirring often, until the rice is completely tender and the mixture has thickened to a loose porridge. It thickens more as it stands.
Whisk a ladle of the hot pudding into the beaten egg, then stir the egg mixture back into the pot. Cook 1 to 2 minutes more, stirring, until glossy. Do not boil hard or the egg will curdle.
Take the pot off the heat. Stir in the honey, vanilla, and 1/2 teaspoon Ceylon cinnamon.
Serve warm with another dusting of cinnamon on top, or chill and serve cold. Leftovers keep 3 days in the fridge and loosen with a splash of milk when reheated.
